items.text: title: dark | text: Dark theme. Switch the desktop color scheme between dark mode and light mode; night theme, black interface.
title: nightlight | text: Night Light. Warm, yellowish screen colors that reduce blue light and eye strain; tired eyes, reading at night.
title: dnd | text: Do Not Disturb. Silence and hide notifications and alerts.
title: vol | text: Volume. Turn the speaker sound up or down, louder or quieter, mute audio output.
title: mic | text: Microphone mute. Mute or unmute the microphone input for calls.
title: bright | text: Display brightness. Make the screen brighter or dimmer.
title: kbd | text: Keyboard backlight. Turn keyboard illumination on or off.
title: wifi | text: Wi-Fi. Turn the wireless network and internet connection on or off, join a network.
title: bt | text: Bluetooth. Turn Bluetooth on or off, connect wireless headphones, earbuds, speakers and devices.
title: plane | text: Airplane mode. Disable all wireless radios at once.
title: vpn | text: VPN. Connect or disconnect the virtual private network.
title: perf | text: Power profile. Choose performance, balanced or power saver to extend battery life.
title: lock | text: Lock screen. Lock the session so a password is needed.
title: sleep | text: Suspend. Put the computer to sleep.
title: shot | text: Screenshot. Capture an image of a region or the full screen.
title: rec | text: Screen recording. Start or stop recording a video of the screen.
title: close | text: Close window. Close the currently focused application window.
title: float | text: Floating window. Make the focused window float above the tiled layout.
title: timer | text: Timer. Start a countdown timer for a number of minutes.
title: lamp | text: Room light. Turn the smart home room lamp or flashlight on or off.
